Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is an affinity purification (AP-MS) study using stably expressed tagged proteins (WDR60/WDR34) to identify interacting partners. The primary biological variable is the expression of these specific transgenes compared to tag-only controls. While the paper discusses KO cells and SAG treatment, those are used for immunofluorescence and VIP assays, not the nano-LC MS/MS proteomics described in the methods and PRIDE metadata.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: PRIDE metadata explicitly lists TMT as the quantification method and the text describes TMT experiments using peptide abundance ratios.

The text mentions GFP-Trap experiments where peptide abundances were calculated as ratios of peptides detected with tagged proteins divided by GFP alone, which is characteristic of label-free quantification (LFQ) in AP-MS.
